name: 85383 · Peoria, AZ
findings: ZIP 85383 (Peoria) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85383 (Peoria) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85383 (Peoria) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
